## TL;DR

Task #1059 adds a shared **docs/bookkeeping-only fast path** for `repoos check`, handoff, and close-out. When every changed path is on a conservative allowlist, the gate runs repository guards only and skips build, tests, browser checks, and remote validation, logging `docs/bookkeeping-only diff: full suite skipped`. Review pass 2 caught two regressions: treating an **empty** changed-path list as a match (because `Array.every` is vacuous on `[]`) and **progress accounting** that never reached 100% in skip mode. Both are fixed; close-out alone may pass `allowEmpty: true` for no-op merges.

## Work and rationale

The motivating incident was weekly worktree cleanup (#1055): eleven files under `work/` still queued remote validation and ran the full vitest suite on every handoff retry. That waste repeats whenever agents land reports, round JSON, or task markdown without touching `src/`.

Classification lives in `src/core/check-docs-only.ts` with a single `DOCS_ONLY_SKIP_REASON` string reused by the CLI, handoff, and integration orchestrator. Allowed prefixes are `work/`, `docs/`, `user-docs/`, `inputs/`, and `schedules/`; any `*.md` outside `src/`, `scripts/`, and `tests/`; everything else—including manifests, lockfiles, `repoos.toml`, and `.githooks/`—forces the full gate. Git failures to list paths yield `null` and fail closed.

`runCheckPlan` in `src/commands/check.ts` accepts a `docsOnly` flag: it still runs `format`, `lockfile-sync`, `zero-runtime-deps`, and `task-assets`, skips other plan steps with the shared reason, and appends an explicit `task-parser` step (parser reads every `work/*.md`). Handoff mirrors the same predicate before `runRemotePreReviewGate`. Close-out skips `planCloseOutGateFor` and remote validation when classified docs-only; only close-out passes `{ allowEmpty: true }` so a merge with zero file delta can still skip rebuild when appropriate (#0355).

Configuration is `check.docsOnlySkip` (default `true`) in `getConfigSchema` and Settings → Advanced, without editing the repo’s `repoos.toml` for this task.

## Approaches tried

The first implementation used `paths.every(...)` without guarding `paths.length === 0`. That made a clean checkout on `main` (zero paths vs `main`) look like a docs-only diff and skipped the full suite—exactly the failure mode review pass 2 flagged. The fix treats empty as non-matching unless `allowEmpty` is set, reserving that opt-in for close-out only.

Progress reporting initially counted only non-skipped steps toward `stepsDone` while `stepsTotal` included docs-only-skipped steps plus the synthetic task-parser step, so UIs showed stalled progress during handoff checks. Docs-only mode now counts every pushed result toward `stepsDone` and sets `stepsTotal` to runnable steps plus one for task-parser.

An older duplicate classifier in `integration-orchestrator.ts` was removed in favor of the core module so handoff, CLI, and close-out cannot diverge.

## Challenges and blockers

Balancing **no-op close-out** (#0355) against **ordinary `repoos check` on a clean tree** required an explicit option rather than one global rule for empty diffs. Close-out must sometimes skip build when the merged candidate introduces no behavioral delta; a local engineer running `repoos check` on an unchanged branch must still run the full plan.

The task spec originally mentioned editing `repoos.toml` steps; AGENTS.md and landing rules forbid touching `repoos.toml` on this branch, so behavior is implemented in code with an optional settings override only.

Scoped self-check and the full gate can be slow on this repo; verification uses `REPOOS_CHECK_CHANGED=main` for the handoff bar while merge still runs the full suite.

## Key learnings

Vacuous truth on empty iterables is an easy footgun for “all paths match allowlist” predicates—always decide explicitly whether zero paths means “nothing changed” (full gate) versus “nothing to validate” (close-out only).

Centralizing skip reason text and classification in `src/core/` keeps CLI, server handoff, and close-out aligned; table-driven tests in `check-docs-only.test.ts`, `check-runner.test.ts` (docs-only gate + progress), `handoff.test.ts` (no remote queue), and `mtd-docs-fast-path.test.ts` (close-out + `allowEmpty`) lock the behavior.

Release profile and `docsOnlySkip = false` remain full-suite paths by design so release and opt-out never silently weaken the gate.
